_comment: Single source of truth for per-pack participant roles — key, label, icon, color, and invite-page copy. The backend (api/index.js) reads this directly for email/notification/event-log role labels (pack-agnostic — it never hardcodes role keys). Frontend workflow pack files (ui/src/lib/workflowPacks/*.js) import this same file as their `roles` export, and DealRoomPage/CommentsPanel look up role metadata scoped by packId instead of a flat cross-pack dict, so role keys can safely differ in meaning across packs (e.g. `lender` means something different in cre_acquisition vs business_acquisition).

roles.label: Coordinator
roles.headline: Manage the transaction and coordinate every party
roles.subtext: As the property owner, you have a full view of all parties, documents, compliance status, and deal progress. Share the role-specific links below to invite each party.

roles.label: Buyer
roles.inviteAction: upload and review buyer-side transaction documents
roles.headline: Review diligence materials and confirm buyer-side readiness
roles.subtext: As the buyer, review assigned diligence documents and upload the materials your side owns in the checklist above.

roles.label: Seller
roles.inviteAction: upload and review seller-side transaction documents
roles.headline: Provide seller disclosures and confirm transaction readiness
roles.subtext: As the seller, upload the financial, property, and disclosure documents assigned to your side and track outstanding requests.

roles.label: Legal Advisor
roles.headline: Review legal structure, title, and compliance materials
roles.subtext: As the legal advisor, review the assigned purchase, title, survey, and compliance documents and flag issues before closing.

roles.label: Financial Advisor
roles.headline: Review financial diligence and transaction risk
roles.subtext: As the financial advisor, review the assigned financial, insurance, and property diligence documents and surface follow-up items.

roles.label: Lender / Underwriter
roles.headline: Review the financial package and provide underwriting feedback
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. As a lender, you have access to the financial package, risk score, compliance status, and AI-analyzed documents.

roles.label: Inspector
roles.headline: Upload your inspection report and property condition findings
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. Upload your inspection report in the checklist above.

roles.label: Insurance Broker
roles.headline: Provide insurance certificates and coverage documentation
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. Upload the insurance certificate in the checklist above.

roles.label: Attorney
roles.headline: Review legal documents, title materials, and compliance items
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. Review legal structure documentation, title history, and compliance items.

roles.label: Investor
roles.headline: Review the investment package and financial performance data
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. Review the investment readiness and financial performance data.

roles.label: Servicer
roles.headline: Manage draw requests, borrower financials, and covenant tracking
roles.subtext: Legacy CRE role retained for existing rooms. Access servicing and covenant tracking materials.

roles.label: Franchisor / Brand
roles.headline: Review the Property Improvement Plan and brand standards compliance
roles.subtext: As the franchisor representative, you can review the Property Improvement Plan, brand standards compliance, and flag any requirements before deal close.

roles.label: Buyer
roles.headline: Manage the acquisition and coordinate all parties
roles.subtext: As the buyer, you have a full view of all parties, documents, and deal progress. Share the role-specific links below to invite your advisors and the seller.

roles.label: Seller
roles.inviteAction: review the documents and confirm you're ready to proceed
roles.headline: Upload financial disclosures and confirm readiness to proceed
roles.subtext: As the seller, upload your financial statements and disclosures in the checklist above, and track the buyer's progress toward closing.

roles.label: CPA / Accountant
roles.inviteAction: review the quality of earnings report
roles.headline: Review financial statements, tax returns, and quality of earnings
roles.subtext: As the CPA, review the financial statements, tax returns, and quality of earnings report uploaded in the checklist above.

roles.label: Legal Counsel
roles.headline: Review the purchase agreement and disclosure schedule
roles.subtext: As legal counsel, review the purchase agreement and disclosure schedule uploaded in the checklist above.

roles.label: Lender
roles.headline: Evaluate financial statements and quality of earnings for financing
roles.subtext: As the lender, review the financial statements and quality of earnings report uploaded in the checklist above to evaluate financing.

roles.label: M&A Broker
roles.headline: Coordinate the transaction and track progress across all parties
roles.subtext: As the M&A broker, you have visibility across all deal parties. Track document status and share role-scoped links with each party.

roles.label: Founder / CEO
roles.headline: Manage the round and coordinate all parties
roles.subtext: As the founder, you have a full view of all parties, documents, and round progress. Share the role-specific links below to invite your investor, counsel, and auditor.

roles.label: Investor
roles.inviteAction: review the data room and term sheet
roles.headline: Review the term sheet, financials, and cap table
roles.subtext: As the investor, review the term sheet, financials, and cap table uploaded in the checklist above to evaluate this investment.

roles.label: Legal Counsel
roles.headline: Prepare and review the stock purchase agreement and disclosures
roles.subtext: As legal counsel, prepare and review the stock purchase agreement and disclosure schedule uploaded in the checklist above.

roles.label: Auditor
roles.headline: Upload audited financial statements for investor review
roles.subtext: As the auditor, upload the audited financial statements in the checklist above for the investor's review.

roles.label: Placement Agent
roles.headline: Coordinate the round and track document status across all parties
roles.subtext: As the placement agent, you have visibility across all parties. Track document status and share role-scoped links with each party.

roles.label: Token Issuer
roles.headline: Manage the token issuance and coordinate all parties
roles.subtext: As the token issuer, you have a full view of all parties, documents, and issuance progress. Share role-specific links below to invite your investors, legal counsel, compliance officer, and transfer agent.

roles.label: Lead Investor
roles.inviteAction: complete KYC and review the Token Offering Memorandum
roles.headline: Review the Token Offering Memorandum and complete investor onboarding
roles.subtext: As the lead investor, complete your KYC/AML verification and review the Token Offering Memorandum, subscription agreement, and cap table uploaded in the checklist above.

roles.label: Legal Counsel
roles.inviteAction: review the offering documents and regulatory filing
roles.headline: Review offering documents, subscription agreements, and regulatory filings
roles.subtext: As legal counsel, review the Token Offering Memorandum, subscription agreements, and regulatory filing uploaded in the checklist above. Flag any structural or compliance issues.

roles.label: Compliance Officer
roles.inviteAction: review KYC/AML documentation and regulatory filing
roles.headline: Review KYC/AML documentation and confirm regulatory compliance
roles.subtext: As the compliance officer, review all KYC/AML completion certificates, investor accreditation documents, and the regulatory filing to confirm the issuance meets the requirements of the governing jurisdiction.

roles.label: Transfer Agent
roles.inviteAction: review the capitalization table and token distribution schedule
roles.headline: Review the cap table and manage token distribution records
roles.subtext: As the transfer agent, review the capitalization table and token distribution schedule uploaded in the checklist above. Confirm investor registrations are complete before issuance.
